notes: Executable Vosne-Romanee vineyard-management law from the current 2025 ministry source. The two-year Guyot-double cordon-establishment exception remains unmodeled rather than generalized.

constraints.notes: Rows require >=9,000 vines/ha, <=1.25 m row spacing and >=0.50 m vine spacing; foule uses >0.50 m spacing and stakes. Ordinary red pruning is capped at eight buds for the encoded systems. Trellised canopy height is >=0.6 times row spacing. Parcel crop load is <=9,000 kg/ha. Irrigation is prohibited. The 20% dead/missing-vine trigger feeds the national D.645-4 proportional-yield remedy.
